#+PROPERTY: header-args :mkdirp yes :main no

* Test data for the ~bazel-fix-visibility~ test

#+BEGIN_SRC bazel-module :tangle MODULE.bazel
bazel_dep(name = "rules_cc", version = "0.2.17")
#+END_SRC

#+BEGIN_SRC bazel-build :tangle BUILD
load("@rules_cc//cc:cc_binary.bzl", "cc_binary")

cc_binary(
    name = "bin",
    srcs = ["bin.cc"],
    deps = ["//lib"],
)
#+END_SRC

#+BEGIN_SRC c++ :tangle bin.cc
// Dummy C++ file
#+END_SRC

#+BEGIN_SRC bazel-build :tangle lib/BUILD
load("@rules_cc//cc:cc_library.bzl", "cc_library")

cc_library(
    name = "lib",
    srcs = ["lib.cc"],
)
#+END_SRC

#+BEGIN_SRC c++ :tangle lib/lib.cc
// Dummy C++ file
#+END_SRC

** Merged standard output and error from Bazel

To make the test hermetic, we generate Bazel output statically and tangle the
output when running the test.  Execute this code block with =C-c C-v C-e= to
regenerate the Bazel output:

#+BEGIN_SRC sh :noweb yes :results output scalar :wrap "src fundamental :tangle bazel.out"
set -eu

org="$(bazel --quiet info workspace)/testdata/fix-visibility.org" || exit
dir="$(mktemp -d)" || exit

# Set up a basic repository layout in the temporary directory.
cp -- "${org:?}" "${dir:?}/.tangle.org" || exit
emacs --quick --batch --visit="${dir:?}/.tangle.org" \
  --funcall='org-babel-tangle' || exit

(
  set -eu
  # We explicitly compile with the current directory set to a subdirectory to
  # ensure that repository-relative filenames still work as expected.
  cd "${dir:?}/lib" || exit
  # Invert the exit status of “bazel build” because we expect it to fail.
  ! bazel --nohome_rc --quiet build --attempt_to_print_relative_paths --nobuild //... 2>&1
) || exit

rm -r -f -- "${dir}"
#+END_SRC

#+RESULTS:
#+begin_src fundamental :tangle bazel.out

ERROR: Analysis of target '//:bin' failed; build aborted
ERROR: Build did NOT complete successfully
#+end_src
